rules: counts are measured from committed job outputs at repo_head
reach is not yield: orders a unit could advance one step, not orders made ready
AI statuses are hypotheses; no codebook change; no tier promotion; certified stays 0

stack.reading: an order can only be made ready by stacking units from several frames; steps no frame reaches stay per-order work

reading: Reach counts are upper bounds on one-step advances.  Frames overlap, so reaches must not be added.  A frame beats the order baseline only if few units reach many orders (high Gini, top-10/100 coverage) AND the step they advance is the one that blocks readiness.  Yield is not estimated here.
step_matrix_reading: steps with an empty views map have no frame that places a unit on them (a measured gap, not a judgement)

frames.polya_move: baseline: the formulation every prior plan used

frames.unit: one acting instrument that revokes/supersedes/terminates others
frames.polya_move: change the unknown: solve the actor, not the target

frames.unit: one acting order whose target-naming provision is not located
frames.polya_move: auxiliary element: the missing link is the actor's located provision
generalize: one document read serves every order it contains or cites

frames.unit: one legal family or X1 text cluster
frames.polya_move: analogy: prove the rule once, check each member briefly

frames.unit: one owner decision or codebook reading question
frames.polya_move: work backwards to the precondition nobody can compute: a human ruling
frames.advances_step: the gated blocker (reach is a ceiling)

frames.polya_move: decompose the unknown by data type; build each producer once
auxiliary problem: build the current-law predicate table once

top20_units.unit: current_law_citation|10 U.S.C. subtitle A, pt. II, ch. 57 note

frames.unit: one source URL the reviewer reads, or one near-ready step set
frames.polya_move: work backwards: start from what the independent human must check

frames.unit: one blocker category (possibly many research actions)
frames.polya_move: specialize: inspect cases sharing one recorded blocker category

input_snapshot.basis: Exact consumed bytes; repo_head alone does not establish output freshness.
